description: 📑 PageIndex: Document Index for Vectorless, Reasoning-based RAG
summary: PageIndex builds a hierarchical tree index over a document and lets an LLM reason its way to the right section instead of doing cosine similarity over chunks, which is the retrieval pattern I actually want for grounding a résumé against a long job description in Proreerfolio without maintaining a vector store. The local SDK is just `pip install` plus your own API key, the tree is human-readable so you can trace why a particular paragraph was pulled, and the whole thing drops into an agent loop as a tool call. I've been hand-rolling tree-walkers for reading long bioinformatics protocols, so a composable, observable alternative to the "chunk and embed everything" default is exactly the kind of small system that removes toil.
